start: Admin app as the owner, AI Assistant opened for the first time, gym on a yearly Pro plan

steps.action: Open the AI Assistant and tap the credits at the top
user_sees: Sheet "AI credits"
"Starter credits" +20 and "Free credits for this month" +100
must_not: Free credits for a trial or monthly plan

steps.action: Ask the assistant to send a message to a member and confirm
user_sees: The message sent; the balance goes down by 1
must_not: A credit taken for the question itself
Two credits taken for one task

user_sees: The task done, 1 credit

start: Admin app as the owner, AI Assistant, plans switched on

steps.action: Ask for a workout plan for a member and save it
user_sees: "Workout plan saved" costs 3 credits; the balance goes down by 3

start: Admin app, AI Assistant, 0 credits left

steps.action: Confirm a task that sends a message
user_sees: "You have no AI credits left. Ask MettleUp for credits to send this."
must_not: The message sent with no credit

steps.action: Open the AI Assistant as front desk staff
user_sees: No wallet for the desk
must_not: The desk spending the owner's credits

start: Admin app, a task whose credit was spent and then failed half way

steps.action: The app gives the credit back within 10 minutes
user_sees: "Credits given back" in the list; the balance back up
must_not: The task still shown as done

steps.action: The month ends with 30 free credits unused
user_sees: Next month "Unused free credits ended" and the new month's free credits
must_not: Last month's free credits carried over

start: Admin app, AI Assistant history with tasks naming members

user_sees: Tasks older than 400 days gone; their credits still counted
must_not: The request words still kept after 400 days

start: HQ app, a gym's page, AI credits

user_sees: Balance, this month's spent, tasks done, added and free given, the last 20 lines
The balance up by 50, the note in the list
One HQ log line with who added it

start: HQ app, a gym paid for a pack of 150 credits

user_sees: "Credits bought" +150 on the owner's sheet
must_not: A purchase with a minus amount

start: HQ app, a gym with 10 credits

user_sees: A refusal: not enough credits
A refusal

steps.action: Add credits to a gym deleted a moment ago
user_sees: A refusal that the gym is gone
must_not: A credit line for a gym that does not exist

start: HQ app, 50 credits added by mistake

steps.action: Take back 50 credits with a note
user_sees: The balance back down; both lines in the list
must_not: The first line deleted instead of a new minus line

start: HQ app, a gym's AI wallet

user_sees: Each spend's note (the first words of the owner's request, which can name a member)
must_not: The wallet opened with the public app key

start: Night: the HQ Worker runs after the nightly clean-up

user_sees: Requests older than 400 days deleted for every gym; spend notes older than 400 days cleared; credit amounts kept
must_not: Only gyms that still use the assistant cleaned

start: First wallet read of a new India month, a yearly Starter gym

user_sees: "Free credits for this month" +50 once
must_not: Free credits added twice from two tabs

start: The purge function is called with the public app key

user_sees: A refusal

start: A gym whose yearly plan ran out last month with 20 free credits unused

steps.action: The first wallet read this month
user_sees: "Unused free credits ended" -20 dated last month; no new free credits
